the sacred space of undefined why feeling lost is the moment you start building your authentic life one of the most profound anxieties we face in the journey of selfimprovement isnt failure its the terrible quiet panic of being undefined we live in a world that demands instant labeling who are you what do you do what is your purpose if you are currently in a transitionmaybe healing from a deep loss pivoting careers or simply realizing the identity you built in your 20s no longer fitsyou know the intense discomfort of that undefined space it feels like floating without an anchor and our immediate toxic instinct is to grab the nearest label just to feel solid again but i want you to reframe this moment the undefined is not a failure state it is the foundation when we are undefined we are fundamentally unlimited we havent yet restricted our potential based on who we think we should be that nagging discomfort thats not a flaw thats the universe clearing the slate so you can write the truest definition of yourself free from inherited expectations or outdated definitions heres how to treat this undefined period not as a holding pattern but as the most powerful creative stage of your selfhealing journey 1 shift from destination to curiosity stop demanding a fiveyear plan when you feel undefined your energy is better spent on investigation than declaration ask yourself what activities make me lose track of time what environments make me feel deeply safe what problems am i drawn to solving even if they arent my job actionable step for the next week replace the thought i need to figure out my purpose with i am curious about what nourishes my soul today give yourself permission to explore random interests without the pressure of monetization or commitment 2 live by values not by titles when your title or role is unclear your core values become your compass if you prioritize integrity connection and creativity you dont need to know if youre a painter a programmer or a parent yet you just need to ensure every action you take today reflects those values the label will eventually catch up to the authentic actions 3 embrace the microexperiment the most damaging thing we do in the undefined space is wait for a grand epiphany instead treat your life like a lab commit to small reversible definitions for 30 days for the next month i am someone who dedicates the first hour of the day to quiet reflection for the next two weeks i am someone who prioritizes deep connection with friends if the experiment feels expansive and authentic keep the practice if it feels restrictive release the definition without judgment you are slowly gathering the data points that will form your new truer identity the defining moment being undefined is an invitation it is the moment where we stop seeking external approval and start listening inward be patient be curious and trust that the most authentic definition of you is already unfolding in the messy beautiful ambiguity

any big changes from balance pt what people actually experience standing on a squishy cushion with eyes closed feels like tortureand i dont see progress if that sounds familiar youre not alone many people doing balance physical therapy pt wonder is this actually helping why does it feel so hard with so little feedback am i doing something wrongor is balance just slow to improve lets break down whats really going on what research and clinicians say and what options people explore when motivation drops why balance pt feels so difficult and slow balance exercises often look simplebut theyre neurologically demanding your balance system relies on three inputs 1 feet joints proprioception what the ground feels like 2 eyes visual system where you are in space 3 inner ear vestibular system motion and orientation exercises like standing on a soft cushion with eyes closed intentionally remove visual cues to force your nervous system to adapt the problem progress is subtle not obvious improvements happen internally before you feel stronger motivation drops when theres no immediate feedback that doesnt mean its uselessbut it does explain the frustration does balance pt actually work yesfor many people but results depend on consistency how well exercises match the persons needs and whether the nervous system is being stimulated effectively clinical studies show balance training can improve stability reduce fall risk and enhance coordination over time however many people quit early because exercises feel repetitive difficulty jumps too fast or they dont understand why theyre doing each drill why some people look for alternatives or addons when motivation drops people often look for approaches that give more sensory feedback feel less monotonous or make the nervous system wake up faster thats where footbased sensory stimulation and neurofocused balance methods come up in conversationsnot as replacements but as adjuncts the feet contain thousands of nerve endings stimulating them can increase body awareness improve signal clarity to the brain and make balance exercises feel more responsive some programs use simple physical tools often spiked or textured balls combined with guided movements to change how balance training feels especially for people who stall with standard pt drills the key insight most people miss balance isnt just about trying harder its about clear sensory input appropriate challenge repeatable understandable progress when exercises feel like torture with no payoff its usually a program design issue not a personal failure what you can do next no pressure if traditional balance pt feels overwhelming or discouraging talk to your pt about modifying difficulty ask why each exercise matters consider sensorybased approaches that focus on foot awareness and nervous system feedback if youre curious you can read a deeper educational breakdown on my blog or explore an optional balance tool guided program both links are there only if you want to learn moreno obligation no hard sell final takeaway if youre struggling with balance pt youre not broken youre not weak and youre definitely not alone balance improvement is realbut it works best when the nervous system is engaged informed and supported not punished

super immersive space for anyone to learn quantum computing through zachlike openended logic puzzles and compete on leaderboards and lots of community made content on finding the most optimal quantum algorithms the game has a unique set of visuals capable to represent any sort of quantum dynamics for any number of qubits and this is pretty much what makes it now possible for anybody 12yo to actually learn quantum logic without having to worry at all about the mathematics behind this is a game super different than what youd normally expect in a programming logic puzzle game so try it with an open mind stuff youll play learn a ton about boolean logic bits operators nand or xor and and classical arithmetic adders learn how these can combine to build anything classical you will learn to port these to a quantum computer quantum logic qubits the math behind them linear algebra su2 complex numbers all turingcomplete gates beyond clifford set and make tensors to evolve systems freely combine or create your own gates to build anything you can imagine using polar or complex numbers quantum phenomena storing and retrieving information in the x y z bases superposition pure and mixed states interference entanglement the nocloning rule reversibility and how the measurement basis changes what you see core quantum tricks phase kickback amplitude amplification storing information in phase and retrieving it through interference build custom gates and tensors and define any entanglement scenario control logic is handled separately from other gates famous quantum algorithms explore deutschjozsa grovers search quantum fourier transforms bernsteinvazirani and more build see quantum algorithms in action instead of just writing reading equations make watch algorithms unfold step by step so they become clear visual and unforgettable quantum odyssey is built to grow into a full universal quantum computing learning platform if a universal quantum computer can do it we aim to bring however be using it as a noun here because the eldritch in these stories do not have any particular rules on what kind of thing they are a more general definition is that an eldritch is some force presence embodiment or entity that is fundamentally unknowable only fragments of it can be comprehended its entirety can never be known at once attempting to do so often leads to a total madness now for the aspects on the chart human connection the eldritch exists in service as a complex way to explore human choices emotions actions etc the terror is the hook but its the people who matter abomination the eldritch is a representation of the human minds resiliency or lack thereof against the unknowable human interaction acts in service to its mystery fundamental the eldritch embodies realworld physical notions such as time forces concepts elements etc it is a vast and ubiquitous presence in our universe akin to a god incomprehensible the eldritch completely exists outside of time and space every aspect of its being is totally foreign to our understanding of the universe reality breaks down under its mere presence intentionally or otherwise runnerup ideas for the chart axes are as follows presence the eldritchs existence permeates throughout everything vs the eldritch is hidden to all but those who are already aware of it awareness the eldritch is sentient and has often unknowable goals and any action it takes is likely intentional vs the eldritch is a deterministic force whose mechanisms can never be altered without drastic consequences relatability we are to the eldritch what a skin cell is to a person vs the eldritch communes with and is aware of humans scope the eldritch is some intrinsic part of our being vs the eldritch expands infinitely throughout all of space and time i decided to format this like an alignment chart because quite a lot of dichotomies arise out of exploring the idea that something can be fundamentally unknowable also because my life this year with stuttering hi to my stuttering reddit community merry christmas to you all and i hope youre having a blessed day i wanted to be honest about how this year has been for me truthfully its been one of the hardest years of my life living with severe stuttering isnt just about speech it affects everything and i know many of you here understand that reality far too well this year ive been unemployed and mostly stuck at home no income no relationship no social life i dont have friends i talk to regularly and even my cousins barely keep in touch anymore sometimes i wonder if people drift away because they dont know what to say to me or because they see me as boring and feel bad admitting it over time i became very antisocial and it hurts to admit how much this disappoints me im 26 years old and because of my stuttering and social anxiety it feels like i cant live the way most guys my age are living i honestly cant remember the last time i had a normal relaxed conversation with a girl around my age thats how isolated ive become its been like this for years since i finished school but this year was by far the worst not working does something to you mentally you start to feel useless you feel like a burden i hate having to ask my parents for money every month especially when they dont earn much themselves theres no allowance and sometimes even our wifi gets cut so i sit at home with nothing to distract me my parents go to work and im left at home with my 72yearold grandmother who is constantly complaining and nagging most days feel long empty and draining this year my life honestly felt dreadful ive applied for jobs everywhere but nothing came through ive tried so many speech techniques over the years whispering dragging sounds pausing different breathing methods but nothing really lasts maybe i havent been consistent enough i dont know i couldnt attend speech therapy this year because financially our household has been relationships i want those things too i want to work earn my own money feel confident look good build friendships and one day be with a kind beautiful woman im tired of living such a lonely life my against the backdrop of personal everyday experiences encountered at the turning point of her midthirties as well as fluctuations in her sense of values the album carefully explores the theme of living by ones own standards rather than someone elses yardstick on the sonic front in addition to longtime collaborators the charm park and ryo lefty miyata the album features a diverse lineup of producers and arrangers including kentaro sakurai and fujibaseboth working with higuchi for the first timeas well as shu kanematsu who also handled arrangements for the ending theme of attack on titan while each contributor brings a distinct color a single unshakable core runs through the album as a whole for this feature higuchi was asked to try audiotechnicas flagship true wireless stereo model the athtwx9mk2 and to speak about its attack texture and overall usability while actually listening to her own album takanori kuroda to begin with could you once again tell us about the theme and concept behind your new album shih shugi higuchi looking back at what prompted the production as ive mentioned before the demolition of my family home was a major event for me see note 1 but beyond that entering the age range of 35 to 36 made me more acutely aware than ever of how differently my peers are living their lives some have families and are raising children others are single and pouring all their energy into their work ive also found myself hearing more from friends who cant do what they truly want or who are struggling with relationships encountering these varied ways of living made me strongly realize that a persons value really does differ from one individual to another because of that it becomes easy to compare yourself to others you start thinking things like that person is more fortunate or im envious because they have something i dont at this age those kinds of feelings tend to surface more readily what i began to think about then was the perspective of viewing myself not through someone elses yardstick but through my own living while facing the version of myself that exists withinrather than measuring myself against othersthat stance is i think the theme that runs throughout the entire album in that sense what kind of responses did you receive from people of your own generation higuchi i often receive letters and among them there was one that left a particularly strong impression the writer said that while pursuing their dream work had become exhausting and during a period when they were thinking maybe i should quit they listened to my songs a lot i initially assumed it would be a story like listening to this song made me want to try harder again but that wasnt it instead they wrote if i quit ill be sad because i wont be able to meet the version of myself who was doing their bestthe self who held on while listening to that songanymore as you get older its not so much major incidents but rather these very small shifts in perspectivethe way a song is received or ones state of mind at that momentthat actually come to carry great significance the fact that they took the trouble to put that feeling into a letter really moved me it also made me feel that im growing up together with them aging together and that realization made me very happy from a sound perspective what kinds of challenges or particular points of focus did you have compared to the previous album higuchi this time i found myself thinking more concretely than before about things like what instruments do i want to include in this song and what kind of sound image do i want to create as before i basically played the piano myself but because we recorded in various studios i was able to encounter many pianos with different personalities even pianos from the same manufacturer can sound completely different depending on the individual instrument experiencing those differences was really fascinating there are probably parts where listeners with a good ear can tell this song and that song use the same piano so i think the inherent character of each piano itself is one of the highlights to listen for this time id also like to ask about your listening habits what kind of monitoring environment do you usually use to enjoy music higuchi when im checking the latest music for songwriting purposes and listening at home i basically use headphones however when im actually composing i often play the sound through speakers if i make demos while my ears are sealed off i feel like my image of the music gets fixed too rigidly at that stage when i want to simply enjoy music i usually listen on earphones while im on the move to begin with i like silence so sometimes ill even walk around with earphones in but without playing any music laughs at home i hardly listen to music at all many musicians are surprisingly like that higuchi i guess thats true when theres music playing at home i get too caught up in it even if music is just faintly coming from the tv i start thinking whos singing or what was that sound just noweverything grabs my attention especially with japanese songs the words catch in my ears and pull my focus in that direction im the type who cant do background listening this time we had you try audiotechnicas athtwx9mk2 to start could you share your first impressions higuchi first of all i was immediately drawn to the matte texture of the case i really like this kind of tactile feel the subdued look that isnt overly glossy is very appealing i thought both the black and the white versions were cute the shape is also somewhat distinctivethe way the corners are rounded off and the clean diagonal line that appears smoothly when you open it the opening and closing action is light and the earbuds themselves are extremely lightweight above all the five lights on the front left a strong impression those lights also indicate the status of the sanitizing function when you close the case uv sterilization activates higuchi oh really thats amazing thats perfect i definitely want things to be sanitized laughs between the white and black versions which color did you prefer higuchi thats a tough choice i usually wear a lot of black so the black version naturally feels right to me at the same time im also conscious of not wanting to be dressed entirely in black all the time and i sometimes think maybe at least my earphones could be a different color the white version of the athtwx9mk2 has gold accents that blend nicely with the skin and i find that really cute how did you find the fit higuchi the part that goes into the ear isnt as deep as a typical inear canal type so it felt very gentle and comfortable to wear i initially thought that a shallower fit might make it unstable but the athtwx9mk2 didnt wobble at all that was a major point for me i wore them continuously on the shinkansen from kobe to yokohama and even then i didnt feel any fatigue with the earphones i usually use my ears get tired quite quickly if i wear them for long periods so i dont really use them much at home but with these there was truly no stress and i found myself thinking i might actually be able to use these normally at home the athtwx9mk2 uses the newly developed pure motion driver and is a highresolution audiocompatible model designed to pursue superior transient response and resolution what was your impression when you listened to it higuchi compared to the earphones i usually use the sound felt much more threedimensional with my usual earphones the sound can sometimes feel tightly compressed into the center almost like a single mass with these it felt as though the sound was placed within a wide space with real depth drums sound like drums guitars sound like guitarsyou can clearly perceive the position of each individual sound theres also a sense that fine details are being properly captured i thought they would be very useful even as earphones for checking sound after recording if you had to recommend one track from shih shugi that listeners should hear first on the athtwx9mk2 which would it be higuchi bokura ga ichiban utsukushikatta toki which is the final track on the album the strings were recorded live so i think you can really feel the texture of the strings and the vibration of the air another one would be ame ga michireba the cello bowing there is quite distinctive with the athtwx9mk2 you can clearly sense even those nuances so i would really like people to listen to it that way when you choose headphones or earphones do you have specific music you listen to as a reference higuchi i often listen to my own songs i have a very clear idea of how i want them to sound and since ive listened to them repeatedly throughout the production process they make for easy comparison so this time i listened a lot to shih shugi as well as masakatsu takagis marginalia its a work where natural sounds are interwoven with piano resonance and i wanted to first check how the piano itself was sounding a piano in essence should contain everythingfrom the moment the felt hammer touches the strings onward but actually hearing all of that clearly is quite difficult the easiest detail to notice is the sound made when releasing the pedal its very subtle but for pianists its a sound that really stands out laughs with the athtwx9mk2 it felt like even the sound of the space itself came through naturally conversely if those elements arent present the piano can start to feel more like an electric piano the same applies to guitars when you can hear the slight squeak of fingers touching the strings or the fine ambient noises that exist around the instrument the sense of realism in the sound is completely different if more people start listening in highquality environments do you think that would change your motivation or attention to detail in sound production higuchi i think it would my voice carries a lot of information so ideally i want people to hear it in good sound quality of course how much someone invests in earphones or speakers varies from person to person laughs but if listening in high quality becomes more commonplace audio equipment will become more accessible as well i feel like there would be more things i could communicate like these strings were recorded with real care just changing the listening environment completely alters how sound is perceived so i hope opportunities like that continue to expand what was your impression of the noisecanceling nc feature on the athtwx9mk2 higuchi im the type who really struggles without noise canceling i dislike surrounding noise in generalairplanes shinkansen anything like thatso i use it almost all the time more than anything i want to block out external sounds as much as possible voices and other ambient noises inevitably distract me even when im writing lyrics i often wear earphones because i want to sense that people are around without actually hearing them thats why earphones that dont cause fatigue are extremely important to me and in that regard the noise canceling on the athtwx9mk2 was very good the athtwx9mk2 also has a lowlatency mode designed to minimize timing discrepancies even in games where precision is critical do you play games regularly higuchi i do there was even a time when i was really into them i mostly play on the nintendo switch and when it became possible to use bluetooth earphones i was genuinely happy in particular splatoon relies heavily on audio timing theres a lot of information you can grasp just by listeninglike the sounds made when someone is submergedeven if its not visible on screen but with bluetooth latency can sometimes occur and even slight differences in delay can make gameplay difficult id like to try splatoon with the athtwx9mk2 i might even get better at it laughs from a users perspective what kind of people would you recommend these earphones to higuchi first people who listen to music regularly not just those who listen a lot but those who want to enjoy music on a deeper level it starts with simply listening to a piece of musicwhether its mine or anyone elsesbut for people who want to savor how the instruments sound and the finer details of the arrangements beyond that i think these earphones are a great fit id also recommend them to people who are satisfied with how they currently enjoy music but who want to know what lies one step deeper within it the athtwx9mk2 can open up that next layer of enjoyment they might be a bit luxurious as a firstever pair of earphones but if you want to expand your musical experience going forward i think they can become a very reliable companion finally when listening to shih shugi with the athtwx9mk2 what points would you like listeners to focus on higuchi about a month has passed since the release so i think many listeners have already engaged deeply with the lyrics and arrangements with these earphones id like them to focus on the presence of the musicians who are performing realizing this song is being played by this person can lead to then i want to listen to this musicians other works as well and that kind of expansion can instantly deepen the way you enjoy music recently even streaming services have started showing performance credits havent they as cds declined there was a period when performers names werent written anywhere and i had long hoped for the culture of credits to return now that we can finally trace them again i really hope people make use of that the athtwx9mk2 are earphones that let you truly see the sound of each individual musician with clarity so id be very happy if listeners could discover their own favorite musicians through them

freedom personal essay this is my understanding of freedom an average indian man living from hyderabad looking back i realise my idea of freedom kept changing as i grew mostly without me noticing it at the time my earliest memory of freedom was playtime school would end and for a short while before homework and dinner the street belonged to us the freedom was small and clearly marked the stretch of road outside our house we played tag ran around got dusty and came back when someones mother shouted loud enough as we grew older play became cricket cricket needed equipment one boy would have the bat everyone else pitched in for the ball around this time i must have been ten i was trusted with small errands buying groceries from the nearby kirana store less than a hundred metres away with that came loose change twentyfive paise fifty paise one or two rupees it didnt sound like much but it was enough to contribute towards a cricket ball the ball became sacred if it went into bushes drains or someone elses house retrieving it was a mission play depended on it that was also when my territory expanded slightly beyond the street but only just i could handle small amounts of money and i was expected to return it correctly a few years later came cycles at first i rented one from a puncture shop for ten rupees a day until i learned properly that changed everything suddenly the neighbourhood opened up new roads gullies slopes that became ramps in our heads we fell got hurt came home bleeding and got scolded for it eventually i got my own cycle almost immediately i was enrolled in a tuition class one to two kilometres away morning rides evening rides playtime shrank but movement increased friends now lived in different neighbourhoods after tuition we explored whatever roads we hadnt yet as long as i reached home by dinner no one asked where i had been by now i had learned that visible injuries led to trouble so i learned to fall better street food entered the picture pani puri bajji all of which still needed money by then my purse limit had reached maybe a hundred rupees i could handle ten and twentyrupee notes i also ran more errands now trusted with larger grocery lists and cash till this point i still avoided main roads school was reached either by a shared auto that picked up multiple children or by a school bus it was safer than public transport by ninth and tenth class that changed school fees went up and i was considered old enough to commute on my own i got a student route pass valid only between home and school it was restrictive but it was my first real interaction with public buses standing at bus stops boarding crowded buses sitting among adults nothing else changed much pocket money stayed low meant mostly for snacks tuition and school still structured my day computer cafs started appearing around then ten rupees an hour to play games like road rash nfs or gta sometimes the games werent the only reason we went internet had arrived along with hormones still the understanding at home remained the same do what you want but reach home safe by dinner miss tuition or get injured and trust would be lost junior college was about fifteen kilometres away this time i got a general student bus pass the kind that allowed travel on any normal city bus suddenly the entire city was accessible my pocket money increased slightly five hundred or sometimes a thousand rupees officially emergency money i wasnt supposed to spend it unless necessary but just having it made me feel different while moving through the city this was during the telangana movement bandhs were frequent many days colleges shut without warning often we found out only after reaching the gate those days gave me my first experience of being free during the day no classes no supervision and nowhere i was expected to be my junior college was close to rtc x roads so thats where we watched most of our movies it was always lively theatres food stalls crowds inside the theatre you could shout whistle scream outside we played cricket in nearby grounds sat in parks or boarded random buses just to see where they went this was also when i began understanding public spaces better creepy old men who touched where they shouldnt uncomfortable silences people trying to scam you with sad stories these things arent spoken about much when they happen but they happen after a while i stopped being carefree and more alert in public spaces by now my cycle felt too small and was passed on to my younger brother i started learning to ride a motorbike with that the city felt even smaller fuel cost money but distance stopped being a concern at home the expectation stayed the same reach back safe by dinner engineering college changed things again it was thirty to forty kilometres away unlike school or junior college attendance wasnt enforced daily there were no phone calls home if you missed class attendance existed as a percentage below sixty percent you were detained between sixty and seventyfive you paid a fine usually by submitting a medical certificate that small difference mattered for the first time no one was checking where i was every day my parents paid for a college bus that picked me up early in the morning and dropped me back in the evening many days i missed it and rode with friends instead we reached college late skipped classes rode around sat at restaurants for hours my pocket money increased to around five thousand rupees it was meant for college expenses but i could spend it as i wished we had to pool money often for alcohol friendships formed and broke people turned out to be opportunistic relationships happened and ended late nights with friends became common permission now had to be asked for if i wasnt coming home for dinner i had to inform beforehand and keep people updated the only time i travelled out of the city by myself during college was for a boys trip to goa it took a lot of convincing my parents funded it fifteen thousand entirely mine for the first time there was no fixed time i was expected back anywhere we overspent got scammed partied wandered and lost track of days at the time that felt like the closest thing to absolute freedom after college i moved to germany for my masters education was free there living expenses werent to get a visa i had to show a blocked bank account proof that i could sustain myself for a year atleast that was the last money i took from my parents from then on everything was on me rent groceries parttime jobs studies time management calls home became weekly checkins i travelled across countries because it was easy i tried experiences because i could afford them i learned how to manage money and time eventually i started working thats when life began to feel repetitive earn spend wait for the weekend i was free in every visible way yet something felt missing i didnt like the idea of relationships or marriage then they felt like constraints when my project ended i chose to return home i wanted to experience the same freedom but without leaving my house behind now i work nearby i can travel orc society and domestic life structure culture and conceptual framing in tolkiens legendarium part 3a of an article on orcs in tolkiens world introduction framing orc society and the problem of internal life written by the orcs of tolkiens legendarium have long functioned as the abjected shadows of middleearth ubiquitous antagonists whose biology social structures and inner lives remain shrouded in mystery and controversy while tolkiens narrative focus falls primarily on their role as soldiers spoilers and victims of cosmological evil a closer readingsupplemented by his drafts letters and secondary scholarshipinvites a more nuanced appraisal how are orcs born do they have domestic space kin relations humour feelings and rebel impulses what is their experience of discipline suffering play or creation can their society be reconstructed and at what epistemological cost this comprehensive essay interrogates these questions across eleven thematic axes reproduction and gender family kinship and domestic space hierarchy roles and labour speech lore songs and humour rituals discipline and punishment children play and education material culture and domestic objects spatial patterns and settlement types gendered violence and reproductive politics narrative function and ethical resonance and finally methodological caution and limits the discussion draws on primary textsthe silmarillion the hobbit the lord of the rings unfinished tales the letters of jrr tolkien the history of middleearthand incorporates theology notably augustines privatio boni as well as critical perspectives from tom shippey verlyn flieger john garth and others what follows is a close sourcedriven synthesis clearly distinguishing indicated evidence from informed inference and always foregrounding the metaphysical tension at tolkiens heart the problem of evil and the ontological status of the orc reproduction and gender in orc society the question of orc reproduction and gender is a vexed one within tolkien scholarship although orcs are depicted almost exclusively as male warriors and laborers both logic and explicit authorial comment imply the existence of female orcs in the silmarillion ch of the coming of the elves it is stated for the orcs had life and multiplied after the manner of the children of ilvatar and naught that had life of its own nor the semblance of life could ever melkor make silmarillion p 50 ed christopher tolkien this sentence heavily weighted confirms the biological underpinning of orcish multiplication they do not simply arise from slime or sorcery but from generation modeled on that of elves and men tolkien makes this even more explicit in his private correspondence in the socalled munby letter letters of jrr tolkien 153 p 191 he writes there must have been orcwomen but in stories that seldom if ever see the orcs except as soldiers of armies in the service of the evil lords we naturally would not learn much about their lives not much was known this direct admission echoed in several fan and critical discussions all but closes the argument regarding the physical presence of females in orc society even if textual visibility is lacking nevertheless the narrative does not introduce individually characterized female orcs this omission has provoked much debate and secondary theorizing some interpret the allmale foregrounding as a consequence of warfocused storytelling cf the lord of the rings esp the two towers others as reflecting tolkiens own ambivalence towards gender roles see lisa coutras tolkiens theology of beauty ch 6 for feminist critical engagement there also lies an unresolved anxiety beneath the breeding of orcsgiven their origin as corrupted elves silmarillion or in later drafts corrupted men history of middleearth vol x morgoths ring questions of sexual violence reproductive coercion and hybridization with men as in the urukhai the two towers book iii the urukhai remain unresolved but are often reconstructed by inference set against tolkiens statements about the boundaries of evil creation and his reticence to ascribe explicit sexual violence to the orcs eg the torment of celebran unfinished tales the history of galadriel and celeborn modern adaptationssuch as rings of power or roleplaying gameshave introduced female orcs to correct or explore this narrative gap but these are noncanonical inventions within the strict tolkienian corpus the question stands female orcs must exist their absence in the stories is an artifact of perspective and genre not worldbuilding family kinship and domestic space among orcs the domestic lives of orcs are kept almost entirely off the stage yet the evidence when combed yields more than might be supposed first familial succession is attested azog chieftain of the misty mountain orcs appendix a the lord of the rings durins folk is father to bolg who leads his people for more than a centurya notable lifespan for orcs suggesting familial houses can exist in the governing echelon bolgs long survival and inheritance from azog indicates at least some transmission of social status through kinship even if the precise mechanisms are opaque cf the hobbit ch 17 the clouds burst descriptions of orcish life in the caves of angband and the mountains also imply the existence of reproductive and domestic environments distinct from the battlefield after the battle of the powers many orcs alongside other servants of melkor survived in the deep caves pits chambers and tunnels of melkors underground fortress angband they multiplied there the silmarillion of the coming of the elves the word multiplied conjoined with chambers and tunnels suggests settlement structures that support more than just male warriors individual orcs like gorbag and shagrat are depicted discussing their prospects as if they had ambitions for a life outside perpetual war their dream of desertion with a few trusty lads the two towers book iv the choices of master samwise betrays a yearning for something approximating domesticitythough this may be more criminal brotherhood than family in the usual sense still their conversation is reminiscent of soldiers seeking a life off the front hinting at an orcish world beyond the armies however warped despite this no scene gives us an explicit glimpse of orc homes with children communal meals or the nurture of young nor are cultural artifacts of domestic life described in detail the silence as noted by verlyn flieger splintered light p 98 and echoed in tom shippey the road to middleearth ch 5 is tellingperhaps a deliberate narrative exclusion echoing tolkiens reluctance to dwell on the likely misery of orcish upbringing john garth tolkien and the great war ch 9 situates this absence within tolkiens wartime perspective where the enemy was encountered as a collective force rather than as family units secondary reconstructions must therefore rely on analogy and context rather than primary textual presence hierarchy roles and labour in orc communities orc society where visible is marked by three persistent traits violent hierarchy unstable alliances and coercive labour tolkiens orcish communities are fissiparous dominated by the rule of the strongest and periodically unified only by the whip of a dark lord in the lord of the rings book iii the urukhai book iv the choices of master samwise internal strife among orcs is frequent and deadly with petty quarrels and sudden violence endemic even within units on active campaign hierarchy is primarily established through might cunning and brutality as exemplified by captains like azog appendix a lotr bolg the hobbit ch 17 the clouds burst gothmog the return of the king book v the battle of the pelennor fields and the various uruk leaders eg uglk in the two towers the social mobility is high but always dangerous with ranks awarded for ferocity or treachery as much as for obedience labour in orc society is thus not only militarized but also deeply coercive noncombat orcs often serve as miners builders of engines and slavesroles marked by constant threat and fear tolkien remarks in the letters 210 p 274 that orcs prefer to do no more work than they can help as they would rather coerce others into working for them this pattern reflects in and out of universe the consequences of a society shaped by dominationwith the suppression of empathy and mutuality as a stable function of power the intervention of morgoth or sauron who unite orcs through fear and imposed direction represents a kind of forced socialization tolkien notes in morgoths ring home vol x p 419 that while under such domination orcs were reduced to an antlike life sauron in particular is noted for his ability to direct the mutually antagonistic orcs against a common enemy holding their hatred against men and elves as a unifying tactic cf the return of the king book v the black gate opens in peacetime such order rapidly dissolves into tribal conflict these intraorc wars attested especially after morgoths fall the silmarillion of the fifth battle nirnaeth arnoediad and before saurons full ascendancy unfinished tales the disaster of the gladden fields make clear that orc society is not a monolith but a patchwork of clashing factions tolkien himself observes in late notes home vol x p 419 that the orkish people thus cycled between periods of unity when they had a dark lord to unite them and disunity when there was no dark lord small quarrelsome tribes hiding in wild places speech lore songs and humour of orcs tolkiens orcs are linguistically distinctive they speak multiple often mutually unintelligible dialects delight in coarse insults and blasphemy and have a penchant for crude humour and irony in the lord of the rings appendix f tolkien remarks their language was actually more degraded and filthy than i have shown it models are easy to find lotr app f p 1137 allen unwin ed the filtered nature of orcish speech in the prosea deliberately bowdlerized versionsuggests that within middleearth their talk would be even more profane and brutal shippey the road to middleearth ch 5 highlights this as tolkiens philological play he hints at linguistic degradation without reproducing it in full the black speech saurons artificial evil esperanto was intended by its creator to be the tongue of all his servants lotr app f but saurons linguistic control was only partially successful orc dialects quickly diverged in their banter orcs frequently revert to an orkish vernacular often interspersed with westron the notorious mordor orc curse uglk u bagronk sha pushdug sarumanglob bbhosh skai the two towers book iii the urukhai translated as uglk to the dungpit with stinking sarumanfilth pigguts gah encapsulates this unique culinary of language playful obscene and relentless in its denigrating creativity orc dialogue especially in critical scenes as between gorbag and shagrat in cirith ungol the two towers book iv the choices of master samwise is laced with gallows humour cynicism resentment and even flashes of moral perspectivehowever bent gorbags sarcastic regular elvish trick demonstrates a kind of dark wit and an ability to apply if twist the language of ethics flieger splintered light p 102 notes that such moments reveal tolkiens unease orcs are given just enough individuality to unsettle their role as faceless villains musical expressionsongs chantsappears sporadically in the hobbit ch 4 over hill and under hill goblins sing warsongs and worksongs such as fifteen birds in five firtrees and clap snap the black crack in the lord of the rings orcs are prone to chanting and jeering eg the return of the king book v the siege of gondor their songs are never elaborate rather wartime experience of soldiers chants and barracks humour refracted through the lens of evil parody rituals discipline and punishment orcish discipline is rooted in fear enforced cruelty and the will
